boot.deck.en: Two rooms, two tables, neither able to see the other. Every hull you lose salvages a heavier weapon, so the fleet that is burning is the one with options.
boot.deck.sl: Dve sobi, dve mizi, nobena ne vidi druge. Vsaka potopljena ladja ti prinese težje orožje, zato ima gorečo floto tisti, ki ima na voljo več možnosti.

lobby.deck.en: Send this code. The match starts the moment they sit down.
lobby.deck.sl: Pošlji to kodo. Igra se začne takoj, ko nasprotnik sede.

seats.title.sl: TA SOBA JE ŽE NA MORJU

seats.deck.en: If one of these was you, take the seat back.
seats.deck.sl: Če je eden od teh tvoj, prevzemi svoj sedež nazaj.

place.hint.en: Pick a hull, then tap the plot to berth it. Tap a berthed hull to lift it again.
place.hint.sl: Izberi ladjo in se dotakni mreže, da jo zasidraš. Dotakni se zasidrane ladje, da jo spet dvigneš.

hint.sonar.en: Pick a centre. You learn how many hulls are in the block, never which.
hint.sonar.sl: Izberi središče. Izvedel boš, koliko ladij je v bloku, nikoli katerih.

hint.decoy.en: Drop it on your own open water. It reads as a hit.
hint.decoy.sl: Postavi jo na svoje prazno morje. Zdi se kot zadetek.

hint.barrage.en: Three shells in a line. Press R to turn it.
hint.barrage.sl: Tri granate v vrsti. Pritisni R za obrat.

hint.reposition.en: Pick an undamaged hull, then a fresh berth. Press R to turn it.
hint.reposition.sl: Izberi nepoškodovano ladjo in novo mesto. Pritisni R za obrat.

hint.depthCharge.en: Nine cells at once. It damages, it does not survey.
hint.depthCharge.sl: Devet polj naenkrat. Poškoduje, a ne razišče.

over.wonLine.sl: {who} nima več nobene ladje na površju.

record.signin.en: Sign in to keep a record

toast.seatTaken.sl: Nekdo drug je prevzel ta sedež

toast.abandoned.en: The other fleet left. The match is void.
toast.abandoned.sl: Nasprotna flota je odšla. Igra je razveljavljena.

refuse.offPlot.en: That is not on the plot

refuse.locked.en: Lose a hull of your own first

refuse.tooManyDecoys.en: You already have two buoys out
refuse.tooManyDecoys.sl: Na vodi imaš že dve boji

refuse.overlap.en: Two hulls cannot share a cell
refuse.overlap.sl: Dve ladji ne moreta deliti polja

refuse.badFleet.en: That is not a whole fleet

refuse.notPlacing.en: Fleets are not being laid right now

refuse.nameTaken.en: That name is taken in this room
refuse.nameTaken.sl: To ime je v tej sobi že zasedeno

refuse.badName.sl: Ime naj ima od 1 do 20 znakov

refuse.badCode.en: A room code is four letters

rules.intro.en: Classic battleship has one problem: once someone finds a hull they sink it on known squares, and the player who found one first usually just wins. All the skill sits in the ten seconds of placement at the start. This version moves it into every turn.
rules.intro.sl: Klasične potapljanje ladjic ima eno težavo: ko nekdo najde ladjo, jo potopi na znanih poljih, in tisti, ki jo najde prvi, običajno preprosto zmaga. Vsa spretnost je v desetih sekundah razpostavljanja na začetku. Ta različica jo prestavi v vsako potezo.

rules.turn.en: One action each, strictly alternating. A hit does not buy you another shot: that rule is the snowball, and it is gone. An action is either a free shell or one tool, paid for with salvage. Spending a tool uses your turn, and that trade is where the game lives.
rules.turn.sl: Vsak po eno dejanje, izmenično. Zadetek ti ne prinese še enega strela: prav to pravilo je snežna kepa in tu ga ni. Dejanje je bodisi brezplačna granata bodisi eno orodje, plačano s plenom. Uporaba orodja porabi tvojo potezo, in prav ta kompromis je bistvo igre.

rules.salvage.en: You earn a salvage for every shell you land, and one for every shell that lands on you. A wreck pays its owner two per cell it was long, so a carrier going down funds a real reply. Area fire pays the gunner nothing: a barrage or a charge feeds the fleet it lands on, and never itself.
rules.salvage.sl: Za vsak zadetek dobiš plen, in enega za vsak zadetek, ki ga prejmeš. Razbitina svojemu lastniku prinese dva na polje njene dolžine, zato potopljena letalonosilka financira pravi odgovor. Ploskovni ogenj strelcu ne prinese ničesar: salva ali bomba nahrani floto, na katero pade, nikoli sebe.

rules.ladder.en: The heavy tools are not bought with a lead, they are salvaged out of your own wrecks. A fleet that is winning fights with a sweep and a buoy. Lose one hull and the barrage and the reberth open; lose two and you get the depth charge. Losing hulls on purpose is a real line, and a losing one: the ladder buys access, not salvage and not turns.
rules.ladder.sl: Težkih orodij ne kupiš s prednostjo, temveč jih rešiš iz lastnih razbitin. Flota, ki zmaguje, se bori s sonarjem in bojo. Izgubi eno ladjo in odpreta se salva in prestavljanje; izgubi dve in dobiš globinsko bombo. Namerno izgubljanje ladij je resnična taktika, a poražena: lestvica ti da dostop, ne plena in ne potez.

rules.rung.en: after {n} of your own hulls go down

rules.sonar.en: Names a three by three and tells you how many hulls are inside it, never which. It costs you something too: the fleet under it is told where you looked.
rules.sonar.sl: Označi polje tri krat tri in ti pove, koliko ladij je v njem, nikoli katerih. Nekaj te tudi stane: flota pod njim izve, kam si pogledal.

rules.decoy.en: A buoy on your own open water. The next shell that finds it reports a hit and pays out exactly like a hull, so the tote board does not give it away. It owns up one turn later.
rules.decoy.sl: Boja na tvojem praznem morju. Naslednja granata, ki jo najde, javi zadetek in izplača enako kot prava ladja, da je semafor ne izda. Prizna šele naslednjo potezo.

rules.barrage.en: Three shells in a straight line, in one turn.
rules.barrage.sl: Tri granate v ravni vrsti, v eni potezi.

rules.reposition.en: Move an undamaged hull to fresh water. A hull they have already touched is pinned, and the new berth cannot use a cell they have searched. They are told a hull moved, never which or where.
rules.reposition.sl: Prestavi nepoškodovano ladjo na svežo vodo. Ladja, ki so se je že dotaknili, je priklenjena, novo mesto pa ne sme uporabiti polja, ki so ga že preiskali. Izvedo, da se je ladja premaknila, nikoli katera ali kam.

rules.depthCharge.en: Nine cells at once. It damages what it touches but does not survey the water it churns, so a charge dropped without a sweep behind it is mostly a very expensive splash.
rules.depthCharge.sl: Devet polj naenkrat. Poškoduje, kar zadene, a ne razišče vode, ki jo razburka. Bomba brez predhodnega sonarja je večinoma zelo drag pljusk.
